description: This file defines CLI commands for the Playwright testing framework, including running tests, managing reports, starting servers, and MCP interactions. It imports various modules, sets up command options, and contains functions to execute these commands.

methods.name: addTestCommand
methods.description: Sets up the 'test' CLI command with options and action to run tests.

methods.name: addClearCacheCommand
methods.description: Sets up the 'clear-cache' CLI command to clear build and test caches.

methods.name: addDevServerCommand
methods.description: Sets up the 'dev-server' CLI command to start a development server.

methods.name: addTestServerCommand
methods.description: Sets up the 'test-server' CLI command to start a test server.

methods.name: addShowReportCommand
methods.description: Sets up the 'show-report' CLI command to display HTML reports.

methods.name: addMergeReportsCommand
methods.description: Sets up the 'merge-reports' CLI command to merge multiple reports into one.

methods.name: addBrowserMCPServerCommand
methods.description: Sets up the 'run-mcp-server' CLI command for MCP browser interaction.

methods.name: addTestMCPServerCommand
methods.description: Sets up the 'run-test-mcp-server' CLI command for MCP test runner interaction.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Executes the test run process with configuration, handling different modes like UI, watch, or full run.

methods.name: runTestServer
methods.description: Starts a test server with specified host and port.

methods.name: mergeReports
methods.description: Merges multiple report files into a single report, with configuration options.

methods.name: overridesFromOptions
methods.description: Creates configuration overrides based on CLI options.
